artworks.title: Shipyard
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel after Herman Saftleven
artworks.medium: chalk manner with etched hatching printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 9.2 × 6.3 cm (3 5/8 × 2 1/2 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic scene near a cabin. There are tall trees and a high horizon in the background. The monochrome palette has various shades of brown, giving a vintage look. The brushstrokes and shading provide depth to the picture. An upturned boat is near the shore with wooden beams scattered around. A simple wooden cabin is next to other buildings blending with the surroundings. Figures are near the structures, and tall trees with foliage form a border against the sky in the distance.

artworks.title: Shipyard
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel after Herman Saftleven
artworks.medium: chalk manner with etched hatching printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 9.2 × 6.2 cm (3 5/8 × 2 7/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving or etching of a rural scene. There is an upturned boat, lumber, and carpentry tools in the foreground. Two rustic buildings are depicted in the middle ground. In the background, there are tall trees creating a canopy. The artwork features fine lines, sepia tones, and skilled shading to convey texture and depth.

artworks.title: Shipyard
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel after Herman Saftleven
artworks.medium: chalk manner with etched hatching printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 9.2 × 6.4 cm (3 5/8 × 2 1/2 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with buildings and trees seen from an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is high, revealing tree tops and rooftops. There are two houses with slanted roofs, a path or bridge over a water feature, and two figures near one of the houses. Tall trees can be seen in the distance. The artwork is detailed with fine brush or pencil strokes, emphasizing texture and form. The color palette is monochrome, with variations of gray highlighting the lines and shading.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Seated Man
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Johannes Kornlein (printmaker), after Cornelis Visscher
artworks.medium: mezzotint with some burnishing printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 30 × 24 cm (11 13/16 × 9 7/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated from the waist up, facing slightly to his left. He has high cheekbones, almond-shaped eyes, a moustache, and a goatee. His hair is styled with soft curls falling around his ears. He is wearing a formal outfit with a voluminous garment, large cuffs, and a wide white collar. His right hand rests at his waist, and the garment has buttons down the front. The background shows a heavy drapery on the right side, with the brim of a hat nearby.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Seated Man
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Johannes Kornlein (printmaker), after Cornelis Visscher
artworks.medium: mezzotint with some burnishing printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 29.8 × 23.9 cm (11 3/4 × 9 7/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up. He is seated with his left arm resting on a surface, and his right hand is visible. The man's face is turned slightly to the right, showing a mustache and wavy hair. He has prominent eyes, a high forehead, and is wearing a coat with button details, a wide collar, and a bow at his neck. There is a draped curtain to the right and a pillar or architectural element beside it in the background. A hat rests on a column behind him. The image is in black and white.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Seated Man

artworks.medium: mezzotint with burnishing printed in light brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 29.7 × 24 cm (11 11/16 × 9 7/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting from the waist up. He has one arm resting on a surface, and is facing slightly towards the viewer. He has a mustache, neatly parted wavy hair, and wears a formal outfit with a dark coat and a white collar peeking out. In the background, there is draped fabric, possibly a curtain.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Seated Man
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Johannes Kornlein (printmaker), after Cornelis Visscher
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 29.8 × 23.8 cm (11 3/4 × 9 3/8 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in a dignified posture, with one arm resting on a surface. His face is turned towards the viewer, and he has distinct facial features with a pointed mustache and delicate expression. He has styled hair with loose curls framing his face and is dressed in traditional period attire. Behind him, there is a draped curtain with a tassel and an architectural element, like a column, in the background.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Seated Man
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Johannes Kornlein (printmaker), after Cornelis Visscher
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 29.7 × 23.9 cm (11 11/16 × 9 7/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person seated. The individual has a high forehead, prominent cheekbones, and a slight mustache. They have middle-parted hair styled in loose curls by their ears. They are wearing a dark, buttoned garment with a white collar and a bow or ruff. There is draped fabric suggesting a robe or outer garment. In the background, a curtain with tassels is partially drawn aside. A table or furniture piece is nearby. Soft shading outlines the figure and surroundings.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Seated Man
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Johannes Kornlein (printmaker), after Cornelis Visscher
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black ink on laid paper and hand-colored with red chalk (proof)
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 29.8 × 23.9 cm (11 3/4 × 9 7/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated man with his upper body slightly angled to the right. He has a finely chiseled face with high cheekbones, a thin mustache, and a small beard on his chin. His hair is medium-length, wavy, and parted down the center. The man's right arm is resting on a surface with his hand elegantly posed. He is wearing a dark garment with a light collar and decorative buttons. The sleeves of the garment are voluminous and gather at the wrists. In the background, there is a large curtain with a tassel hanging down, and a piece of furniture or object to the right. The background is shaded to emphasize the subject.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Seated Man
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Johannes Kornlein (printmaker), after Cornelis Visscher
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 29.8 × 23.8 cm (11 3/4 × 9 3/8 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up. The man is seated with his right arm resting on a surface, and his left arm crossed over his midsection. He has a thin moustache and a slightly receding hairline, with his hair styled in soft waves reaching below his ears. He wears a dark robe with a white collar and a bow tied at the neck, featuring button details down the front. In the background, there are heavy drapery and a column.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Seated Man
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Johannes Kornlein (printmaker), after Cornelis Visscher
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 29.8 × 24 cm (11 3/4 × 9 7/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a seated portrait. He has one arm resting on a surface and the other arm partially visible. His face is turned towards the viewer, displaying delicate facial features, a trimmed mustache, and a soft goatee. He has short, curly hair, and is dressed in a formal, long-sleeved garment with buttons down the front, a lace collar, and cuffs. The background includes a large curtain with elegant folds and a visible tassel on the right side of the image, as well as an indistinct, shaded wall.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Seated Man
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Johannes Kornlein (printmaker), after Cornelis Visscher
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 29.8 × 24.1 cm (11 3/4 × 9 1/2 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body seated. His left hand is resting on a surface, while his right arm is bent with his hand placed at the edge of his clothing. He has a moustache, expressive gaze, wavy hair styled in a middle part, and is wearing a dark garment with visible buttons, a large light-colored collar, and a tie. In the background, there is a curtain with a tassel and a flat surface with an object on it. A signature or inscription is on the wall behind him.

artworks.title: Woman Seated on the Ground with Two Children
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a woman and two children. The woman is depicted in a side profile, seated on her knees in a squatting position. She is wearing a headscarf, long dress with long sleeves, and is holding an infant wrapped in cloth. Beside her, an older child is seated with legs crossed. The background is textured paper.

artworks.title: Seated Old Man
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an older man depicted from the waist up. His head is slightly turned to the left and he appears to be looking downward. He has a full beard and mustache, with a high forehead and thinning hair. He is dressed in a voluminous robe with flowing lines. The background is plain with a neutral backdrop.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: red chalk
artworks.description: A man with a rounded nose and wide, soft jawline looks out at us in this almost square red-chalk drawing. The man’s shoulders angle to our right, and he turns his face to us, his heavy-lidded eyes shadowed under a floppy beret. His thin lips are closed, and he has a goatee. Curly hair frames his face, and one long lock falls over his right shoulder, to our left. A light-colored collar, perhaps lace, lies across his shoulders over a darker garment.

artworks.title: View of Diemen
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.dimensions: sheet (lower right corner rounded): 9 x 22.4 cm (3 9/16 x 8 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The scene in the image depicts a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated angle. A path curves through the image, with the horizon high and featuring faint outlines of structures such as buildings and a church with a spire, partly concealed by trees. The style is expressive, with loose brushstrokes or pencil marks indicating figures and structures. The color scheme is primarily earthy tones like browns and grays, imparting a vintage look. Close to us are vague forms suggesting figures on a path, leading to a more outlined yet still rough illustration of buildings and trees in the distance for depth and perspective.

artworks.title: Beggar Woman Leaning on a Stick
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: brush and brown wash on laid paper, on Richardson album sheet
artworks.description: The image displays a person leaning forward with a walking stick for support. Their face is partially visible with vague features in a shadow-like style. They wear a hat or hood and a long garment with possible additional layers. There is a smaller figure next to them in a similar posture. The background is a simple textured surface.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait, Frowning
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper

artworks.title: Self-Portrait in a Cap: Laughing
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.3 x 4.4 cm (2 1/16 x 1 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is an etching displaying a bust-length portrait of a person viewed slightly from the side, capturing the face and shoulders. The person is turned slightly to their right, with their face angled towards the viewer, displaying a wide grin that covers much of their facial features. They have curly, tousled hair partially covered by a fabric cap. Their attire includes a cloak draped over the shoulders and a shirt with visible buttons. The background of the etching is plain and nondescript, focusing attention on the individual.

artworks.title: Man Crying Out, Three-Quarters Left
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man, captured from about the shoulders up to the top of his head. He is positioned in a three-quarter profile, facing towards his left. The man has a prominent, curly beard and his facial features include a slightly hooked nose and a wide mouth. He is wearing a soft, flat cap that covers most of his hair, which appears to be curly as well. The man's clothing appears to be a loose garment, with a pattern suggesting texture or embroidery on the visible shoulder area. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background of the image is plain, with no distinct features or items surrounding the figure.

artworks.title: Old Man Seen from Behind, Profile to Right
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a person drawn in profile. The person is facing slightly left, looking back over their shoulder. The features include a prominent nose, defined jawline, full beard, and textured hair that suggests a hat with a large plume or fur. The person is wearing a heavy, textured coat or cloak and holds their hands clasped together in front. The background is plain, with aged paper, highlighting the detailed figure.

artworks.title: The Artist's Mother with Her Hand on Her Chest
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a bust of a person, with only the upper body visible from the chest upwards. The individual is seated, with their head slightly inclined forward and to the left, eyes closed. Their facial features include a high forehead and a furrowed expression, complemented by styled or covered hair that frames the face. The person wears a dark cloak or garment with a lighter-colored collar. Their right hand is raised to the chest, holding part of the clothing. The image is a monochromatic etching with a textured background of cross-hatching and dense lines, enhancing the person's form and expression.

artworks.title: The Artist's Mother with Her Hand on Her Chest
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly woman in an etching. She is shown from the chest up, positioned slightly turned to her left and looking downward. Her facial features are detailed, showing pronounced wrinkles, a slightly furrowed brow, and partially closed eyes. Her hair is covered by a dark headscarf draping over her shoulders. She wears a dark garment with a high white collar showing at the neckline and holds the fabric of her clothing lightly with one hand near her chest. The background consists of densely crosshatched lines, creating a textured effect to highlight the figure in the foreground.

artworks.title: Peasant with His Hands behind His Back
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: etching and burin
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a person's body in profile view facing right. The individual is standing, leaning slightly forward with hands behind their back. The person has prominent facial features, including a nose and furrowed lines. Their hair blends into a bushy hat or head covering. The person wears a loose-fitting, long-sleeved garment made of a possibly woolen fabric. The background is subtle without distinct objects or scenery, highlighting the figure.
